g.text: Same 2,000 university examples and 100 PIQA examples at every evaluation
Open marker: pre-training baseline. Filled markers: 11 frozen evaluations. No smoothing.
Shaded: A100 through update 82; L40S thereafter. C_I is flagging, not transmission accuracy.
Active time uses the checkpoint clock before evaluation; queue/restart downtime is excluded.
